channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tony Parker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tony Parker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Green on Tony Parker
item.description:
Danny Green:

“Then Kawhi had the injury, Tony [Parker] said some things in the media, then Pop said some things. And from what I understand, Uncle Dennis was like, 'Nah, we’re not doing that.'Kawhi came back, played nine games, and then suddenly it was, 'You’ve got to talk to Kawhi’s people.' To them, that felt disrespectful. And then you had Tony saying stuff that they felt crossed the line. Next thing you know, the word was: 'He’s not putting on a San Antonio Spurs uniform again.'”

Danny Green on Tony Parker, May 30, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Thompson:

“That’s one of the greatest partnerships ever. You can compare it to peanut butter and jelly. They’re one of the greatest duos of all time. No question about it. They won four championships together. You have to win championships together to be compared to Scottie Pippen and Michael Jordan or to Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar or Tim Duncan and Manu Ginobili and Tony Parker. They are definitely in that category or that conversation.”

Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 12, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Mike Brown on Tony Parker, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“It’s hard-pressed to say who’s faster – Tony Parker or De’Aaron Fox. Maybe Foxy because I’m coaching Foxy now and it’s right in front of me. But Fox’s explosiveness is higher than Tony’s. When Fox gets going with that speed, Fox is going to dunk on you in a heartbeat. If you try to blink when you go over to contest his shot, be careful because he’s going to punch on you. To have that type of speed at his size with his explosiveness or athleticism, that’s why I think he’s different than anybody else who has playedthe game.”

Mike Brown on Tony Parker, De'Aaron Fox, Oct 6, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Mike Brown on Tony Parker
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“I knew Tony Parker's speed was going to be his bread and butter. I didn’t know anyone that had the burst that he had, especially in the open court. He developed a floater off of two feet. I just let him go. I felt he was ready to take on a big role, even as a rookie. I pushed him to let loose and play to his strengths. We developed a bond because of it.”

Mike Brown on Tony Parker, Aug 9, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Vincent Collet on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Gregg Popovich
item.description:
Talking with Yann Ohnona from L'Equipe, Metropolitans 92 head coachVincent Collet, who coaches Victor Wembanyama both in the club and in the French national team, welcomed the draft lottery's result.

“It was the choice I was hoping for. San Antonio is a franchise that has built its legend with foreign players. We saw that in France with the prism of Tony Parker but there was also Manu Ginobili and others. I think Gregg Popovich can be the best mentor for him,”

Vincent Collet on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Gregg Popovich, May 28, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Tony Parker, Jason Kidd, Stephon Marbury
item.description:
Jackson said via Showtime.

“Speedy Claxton saved us. I don't know why they don't talk about Speedy Claxton and give him his props bro. Tony Parker was near the bench every fourth quarter because Steph [Stephon Marbury] was frying him. Jason Kidd was frying him.”

Stephen Jackson on Tony Parker, Jason Kidd, Stephon Marbury, Apr 21, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Becky Hammon
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on being selected for HOF along with Tony Parker & Becky Hammon:

“It’s kind of fun all of us doing it at once. It’s kind of weird. But kind of fun. I love them both.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Becky Hammon, Apr 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Tony Parker
item.description:
Dejounte Murray:

“That was the year I took the job from Tony [Parker]…I know he didn't like it cuz if he liked it, he would have mentored me the way he should have. He wouldn't have went to [the Hornets].”

Dejounte Murray on Tony Parker, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Tony Parker
item.description:
Nicolas Batum:

“After watching him, I talked to Tony Parker because we’re part owners of [French basketball team] ASVEL Basket. I said to Tony,‘Yo, I got the next one. I just saw the next one. I like everybody else, but this kid is insane. He’s gonna be crazy good.’I’ve been following the kid since he was 14 years old, and I’ve had the opportunity to meet his family a couple of times. He’s special.”

Nicolas Batum on Tony Parker, Oct 10, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Josh Primo
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop said if,

“I could really do what I wanted, and I didn't care about anything else in the world, I'd throw (Primo) in the frying pan the way we did Tony Parker.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Josh Primo, Jan 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Pop on how Tim Duncan, Manu Ginobili, and Tony Parker would have handled the bubble had they been playing at this time:

“They would have done it just like every other player. So far the discipline of the players has been great. They would be fine.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Tim Duncan, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Tony Parker
item.description:
“I still talk to him. He comes by the [practice] gym. Tony is Tony. We’re just happy to have him around.… “There will never be another Tony Parker. He is the greatest Spurs point guard ever. Now, it’s up to me to be the greatest Dejounte Murray I can be.”

Dejounte Murray on Tony Parker, Nov 11, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Mantas Kalnietis on Tony Parker
item.description:
Mantas Kalnietis on Tony Parker:

“He was always very positive and really interested how ASVEL works. Tony is an example how NBA champion should live after the retirement. He is very simple, knows what to say and when to show up for the team. His impact in France is just enormous”

Mantas Kalnietis on Tony Parker, Jul 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Kemba Walker on Tony Parker
item.description:
Walker added, co-signing.

“Of course, you want to hear what your coach is saying, but when you have a guy like Tony Parker, a guy who you know has been through it all, a guy who has four championships, Finals MVP.When he’s telling you something, you just understand. That’s Tony Parker, he’s a basketball legend. He’s a future Hall of Famer. Malik’s right. When you see a guy in the same jersey who’s been through it all and knows what it takes to win games in our league, yeah it’s a lot different.”

Kemba Walker on Tony Parker, Oct 22, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Pop on losing Tony Parker:

“That was tough, but he’s going to be in San Antonio forever. ... There’s a time and place for everything. This was really good for Tony.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Jul 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Manu Ginobili, Tony Parker
item.description:
Alvin Gentry, on the Spurs' Tony Parker-infused bench:

“When he and Ginobili step on the court, it goes back to those Phoenix days and it’s a nightmare. I don’t care how old they are or how many years they’ve played.”

Alvin Gentry on Manu Ginobili, Tony Parker, Feb 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Second-year proDejounte Murray has replaced Tony Parker as the Spurs starting point guard and coach Gregg Popovich said Parker handled the change with class.

“He was great. He thought it was good for the team, and giving Dejounte a chance to see what he could do. (Parker) was mature, and really made it easy on me to make a decision like that. He was fantastic.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Dejounte Murray, Jan 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @claybailey9.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Tony Parker, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:More Ginobili:

“So I think we all have to contribute a little more, be more attentive, be more responsible to keep improving and be the team we want to be without Tony Parker or Kawhi Leonard.”

Manu Ginobili on Tony Parker, Kawhi Leonard, Nov 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Tony Parker, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Manu Ginobili:

“We haven’t been as reliable as we have wanted to. I could have expected some droughts, some games where we cannot score that much. But we have had everything so far, bad defensive games, distractions, turnovers, and that doesn’t depend on Kawhi Leonard, Tony Parker not being there.”

Manu Ginobili on Tony Parker, Kawhi Leonard, Nov 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Danny Green on Tony Parker
item.description:
Danny Green:

“[Tony Parker] obviously had a tough injury last year but he's recovering. He's a couple of months ahead of schedule... I don't want to leak anything but he might be playing a lot sooner than people think he's playing. He's been doing his rehab like a monster, like a maniac. He's been working out like a maniac and mentally he's really focused and trying to get his body healthy and get it right. You'll probably be seeing Tony playing a lot sooner than what most people expect him to be back by.”

Danny Green on Tony Parker, Sep 4, 2017. Source: news4sanantonio.com.

item.title: Joffrey Lauvergne on Tony Parker
item.description:
“For the record, Tony (Parker) was spending his holidays in the same place as me. One night, we met in a restaurant by total chance. The next day he called me and said ‘yesterday we were together for 20 minutes and you didn’t even tell me that the San Antonio Spurs were interested in you!’I replied that I didn’t go with the flow and in the meantime, they had called him to take information. Apparently, he pushed the Spurs to sign me,”

Joffrey Lauvergne on Tony Parker, Aug 1, 2017. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Danny Green on Tony Parker
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Green on Parker:

“He looked good. I asked him how life was and how life is going. He’s taking it a day at a time.”

Danny Green on Tony Parker, May 18, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Clint Capela on Tony Parker
item.description:
Rockets centerClint Capela on Tony Parker:

“In France, he's the icon over there. To me, he's the Michael Jordan in France.”

Clint Capela on Tony Parker, May 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Tony Parker
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Manu Ginobili on Tony Parker:

“It's going to be the first playoff game I play without him. It is a little bit strange,a little sad, too.”

Manu Ginobili on Tony Parker, May 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Tony Parker
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:D'Antoni:

“I hate it for Tony Parker. He’s a great guy;not a good guy. You hate to see that with anybody, especially being that serious.”

Mike D'Antoni on Tony Parker, May 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Tony Parker
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Beverley on Parker:

“He's always been a good person to me, always gave me words of wisdom. Definitely prayers up for him.”

Patrick Beverley on Tony Parker, May 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Tony Parker
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Dejounte Murray on learning from Tony Parker:

“I talk to him. If we're at a dinner, anything, I just talk to him. He's a leader.”

Dejounte Murray on Tony Parker, Jan 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Becky Hammon on Tony Parker
item.description:
Becky Hammon:

“Well me and (Spurs point guard) Tony (Parker) were friends long before, so he’s a very good friend. I would actually bounce things off of him, and we had conversations even before I ever got hired. I was kind of charged with point guards a little bit in practice, so if we were doing specific shooting stuff I would work with the point guards, so Cory Joseph was a guy who I worked with a lot. Boris Diaw was my guy on game day, so I was delegated different duties. And obviously the ones who you work the closest with — and obviously I wasn’t working with a lot of post players— you start to get a rapport with them, to build a relationship with them.”

Becky Hammon on Tony Parker, Jul 16, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Quinn Cook on Tony Parker, George Hill
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Quinn Cook:

“I would rather go into the league and learn. I want to learn from vets. I want to learn from Tony Parker… the George Hills (of NBA).”

Quinn Cook on Tony Parker, George Hill, May 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Pop on Parker:

“I think he is healthy. He is getting his rhythm backm which can help you get your confidence back...”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Mar 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaPS.
